item.title: Suspected terrorist infiltration in Havat Maginzi in Samaria
item.description:
Sirens were sounded in Samaria following a suspected terrorist infiltration at Havat Maginzi.
Residents were instructed to enter their safe rooms, securely lock the doors, and remain below window level. Residents are instructed not to leave the safe room until receiving an official notification from the authorities.

item.description: Iranian parliament member Hamid Rezaei has been sentenced to 10 months in the notorious Evin Prison after being convicted of “publishing false statements" against Parliament Speaker Mohammad-Bagher Ghalibaf.

item.title: Itzik Bonzel to Arutz Sheva: I apologized, but Yocheved’s remarks are unforgivable
item.description: Bereaved father and Likud candidate responds to the outcry over his comments about released hostage Yocheved Lifshitz: “How low can one go?"

item.title: MK Yaakov Asher: United Torah Judaism has no desire to bring anyone down or crown anyone
item.description:
United Torah Judaism chairman MK Yaakov Asher responded to reports that the Gur Hasidic movement is considering abstaining from a vote if Gadi Eisenkot succeeds in forming the next government.
“United Torah Judaism has no desire to bring anyone down or crown anyone, and we do not act out of revenge or any other interests. The only thing guiding us is the directive of the leading rabbis, according to which United Torah Judaism, in all its components, will neither support nor join any government without securing the status of Torah scholars," Asher said.

item.title: Trump rejects Axios report: I offered nothing to Iran
item.description: President Trump rejects an Axios report that he offered Iran sanctions relief and frozen funds, insisting, “I offered them NOTHING!"

item.title: Reports in Iran of explosion on Qeshm Island
item.description:
Iranian news agencies reported an explosion that was heard on Qeshm Island on Monday evening.
Iranian state TV later reported that the blasts were likely warning shots aimed at vessels in violation, and did not provide further details.

item.title: Trump on Iran: I stopped them from having a nuclear weapon
item.description: Trump says the Iran war will end “very soon" with a US victory, warning of the global consequences of a nuclear-armed Iran: Israel would be wiped out, there would be no Middle East

item.title: Prime Minister's Office rejects Associated Press report on UAE meeting as 'fake news'
item.description:
The Prime Minister’s Office rejected a report in The Associated Press alleging that Netanyahu specifically requested, during his meeting with UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed, that the UAE President deny a report published earlier this month by Haaretz, stating the UAE President had contacted Netanyahu in late September 2023 to warn him that Hamas was preparing a major attack against Israel.
“Fake news. The visit focused solely on strengthening relations between the two countries and addressing regional challenges," the Prime Minister’s Office said.

item.title: PM's office: UAE visit focused on strengthening relations between the two countries
item.description:
Prime Minister’s Benjamin Netanyahu's Office on Monday evening issued a statement about the Prime Minister's Sunday visit to the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
"Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his wife visited the United Arab Emirates yesterday at the invitation of UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed," the statement said.
"The visit focused on strengthening relations between the two countries and addressing regional challenges. The National Security Council director, Mossad chief, military secretary, and political adviser also took part in the visit."

item.title: “Serious danger to patients:" Health Ministry shuts down private hospital in Tel Aviv
item.description: A surprise inspection conducted by the Ministry at the “Medica" clinic in Ramat Hahayal found medical staff exceeding their professional authority, systemic failures, and an immediate danger to patients.

item.title: 'You should join the dots’: TV host erupts at UK defense chief after suspected terror plot
item.description: 'Why is Israel sanctioned when they provide a lot of our intelligence reports for us?' TalkTV host Alex Phillips blasts Defence Secretary Wes Streeting over the government’s handling of immigration, terrorism and national security.

item.title: Pager plot: Israel’s secret moves to keep Hezbollah in the dark
item.description: Ahead of the US release of a new documentary, details are being allowed for publication from behind the scenes of the pager operation in September 2024.

item.title: UAE: Netanyahu and bin Zayed discussed strengthening relations between the countries
item.description: The official news agency of the United Arab Emirates issued a statement stating that President Mohammed bin Zayed met with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and the two discussed strengthening and developing relations between the two countries.

item.title: The First Call of "Dor's Ambulance"
item.description: MDA paramedic Tzvika Rider, whose son was murdered in Be'eri on October 7, took his first call in the new ambulance dedicated to his son's memory, and it was a woman in labor.

item.title: IDF eliminares 2 suspects who enter Security Zone in Lebanon
item.description:
Earlier today (Monday), IDF soldiers operating in southern Lebanon identified two suspects who entered the Security Zone and approached the soldiers.
Following the identifiction, the soldiers opened fire toward the suspects, the suspects were neutralized. No IDF injuries were reported, the incident is under review.

item.title: Smotrich's response to the Palestinian Authority
item.description: The PA Foreign Ministry issued a statement against comments by Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich, who responded: “The terror authority understands the significance of the settlement revolution."

item.title: Yoseph Haddad's shirt becomes a hasbara tool
item.description: Haddad says his QR-code campaign proves the battle for public opinion is far from over. Now, as No. 2 in Amcha Yisrael, he is taking his advocacy fight into politics.

item.title: Agudat Yisrael fires opening shot in election campaign
item.description: Agudat Israel kicks off its election campaign in Bnei Brak as Elyakim Stark apologizes for failing to protect yeshiva students and calls for unity ahead of a critical battle over the future of the haredi public.

item.title: Intelligence warning in Gaza: IDF and Shin Bet prepare for possible kidnapping attempt
item.description: Following intelligence information, the alert level has been raised for the territorial division and the 99th Division deployed in the Gaza Strip. Senior commanders have been instructed not to leave the sector.
